title: 2027 annual meeting notice and agenda
summary: The 69th annual meeting is Thursday, March 18, 2027, at 6 pm at the Harlow Civic Center, and online.
body:
The 69th annual meeting of Kestrel Valley Credit Union will be held on Thursday, March 18, 2027, at 6 pm at the Harlow Civic Center, 50 Civic Plaza, and streamed online for members.

Agenda

  1. Call to order and quorum
  2. Approval of the 2026 minutes
  3. Reports of the chair, the CEO, the treasurer and the supervisory committee
  4. Election results for three board seats
  5. New business and member questions

title: Minutes of the 2026 annual meeting
summary: Approved minutes of the 68th annual meeting, held March 19, 2026.
body: The 68th annual meeting was called to order at 6:02 pm with 312 members present in person and 188 online. The chair reported on the opening of the Wren Lake branch, and members elected two directors.

title: 2025 annual report
summary: Our year in numbers: members, loans, dividends and community giving.
body: In 2025 we welcomed 2,900 new members, made 4,100 loans in the valley and returned $3.4 million to members in dividends and bonus dividends. Read the full report for the treasurer's and supervisory committee's statements.

title: Board nomination packet, 2027 election
summary: How to apply for one of three board seats. Applications are due December 1, 2026.
body: Three director seats are up for election in 2027. This packet explains the role, the time commitment (about eight hours a month) and how the nominating committee reviews applications.

title: Supervisory committee audit letter, 2025
summary: The supervisory committee's letter on the independent audit of the 2025 financial statements.
body: The supervisory committee engaged an independent firm to audit the 2025 financial statements. The auditors issued an unmodified opinion.

title: Fee schedule
summary: Every fee we charge, in one page.
body: Our fee schedule lists every fee for checking, savings, loans and cards. Most members never pay any of them.

title: Privacy notice
summary: How we collect, use and protect your information.
body: We do not sell member information. This notice explains what we collect, why, and the choices you have.
